title: What is uniquely his: recognizing quality
summary: Gil says his one certainty is that he recognises quality, and he sees himself as a messenger.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Now I know how you feel because you're a beautifully modest man, but is there something that you consider or some approach that you consider uniquely yours at this point? As a jazz musician. Would you consider..........
I think probably, the only thing I'm certain about is that I recognize quality. That's
